author: VuVanDien
reason: Starter prompt/tool declarations before prompt-engineering changes.
hypothesis: Baseline should reveal routing, missing-info, boundary, and multi-turn weaknesses once provider errors are removed.

author: VuVanDien
reason: Add prerequisite and confirmation rules: do not guess asset ID, employee ID, or unsupported environment; confirm before write actions.
hypothesis: Clarification and confirmation boundaries should reduce missing_info and wrong_boundary failures.

author: VuVanDien
reason: Clarify tool descriptions and argument conventions for status, device, KB, user lookup, reports, tickets, and external/public search.
hypothesis: Better tool descriptions should reduce wrong_tool, wrong_arg_value, and unnecessary_tool failures.

author: VuVanDien
reason: Add multi-turn rules plus final guards against employee-ID-as-asset and missing yes/no ticket confirmation.
hypothesis: Multi-turn accuracy and boundary behavior should improve because stale context is suppressed, independent checks are split, and ticket details are treated as a confirmable payload.
